Package comp3607.group10.telemetry.model

Class TelemetryEvent

java.lang.Object
comp3607.group10.telemetry.model.TelemetryEvent
public class TelemetryEvent extends Object
One telemetry event: its type, a millisecond timestamp, the class involved and a map of extra details. Events cannot be changed after they are created.
Author:
Anushka Dwarika

  • Constructor Details

    • TelemetryEvent

      public TelemetryEvent(EventType type, long timestampMillis, String className, Map<String,String> details)
      Creates an event. The details are copied so later changes do not leak in.
      Parameters:
      type - the kind of event
      timestampMillis - when it happened, in epoch milliseconds
      className - the class involved, or null
      details - extra values for the event, such as the error message

    • TelemetryEvent

      className - the class involved, or null
